notes: 'to go' is added on the same terms as in v. 17: 'before' alone is לִפְנֵי's rendering, so no morpheme loses anything when 'to go' is dropped (rule 20).
'yourselves' belongs to the Niphal verb here, where the ASV writes 'arm yourselves' with no emphatic pronoun beside an explicit subject (rule 44) — the mirror of the v. 17 division.
